title: RSH v4.1.0: Additive GLUBALL Lean 4 Formalization for the Robitaille–Slade Helix Evidence Framework
description: RSH v4.1.0 adds the separately versioned theorem surface RSH-GLUBALL-FORMAL-V1, pinned to RSH v4.0.0 and GLUBALL v1.0.0. Lean 4 machine-checks the frozen GLUBALL parameter inequalities, componentwise derivative linkage to the declared centreline, squared-speed positivity and regularity, host-torus normal and frame orthogonality, tube-radius invariance, tube-angle periodicity, centreline closure, exact C3 rotational symmetry, uniform-floor sampling bounds, and mesh-index wrap bounds. The existing RSH-FORMAL-V1 theorem surface and the RSH-EPISTEMIC-V1 / RSH-CONFORMANCE-V1 governance contracts remain intact. The release does not claim global thick-tube embeddedness, IEEE-754 or browser/runtime identity, accelerator correctness beyond declared conformance surfaces, or empirical physical, biological, consciousness, sentience, or qualia validation.
